vaults.purpose: r3-e01-agent-evolution: studio experiment E01, what an agent is: a chat model, one tool, many tools, the loop, integrated, agents calling agents; each step adds reach

request.text: One sentence the audience must understand: an agent is a chat model that was given tools, then more tools, then a loop, then our accounts, and each step added reach. The steps, in order: (1) a chat model answering in a box; (2) one tool; (3) many tools; (4) the loop: it acts, looks at the result and acts again until it decides it is done; (5) integrated: accounts, tokens, other systems; (6) today's agentic flows, agents calling agents. Keep the earlier steps visible as the picture grows. No numbers needed; the loop is Anthropic's own definition in Building effective agents. No dates unless each has a public source; otherwise label the timeline a sketch. A build, each step a few seconds; 40 to 60 seconds; reads as a still at the end. No product logos; no claim that any one product is unsafe; nothing that reads as a forecast. An explainer beside it. Two versions welcome.
